heading: Event Rules & Expectations
intro: We run this mic as a safer and more welcoming space, especially for queer folks and women. Everyone is welcome when they can respect the room, the lineup, and each other.

sections.title: For Performers
items: Performers of all identities are welcome to perform, but please be respectful of the audience and the room.
Harassment, hate speech, or targeted cruelty toward individuals based on their identity is not allowed. Don't be a jerk.
Crowdwork is allowed, but if you are asked to stop, please do so immediately. Consent is required.
If you are a performer and you are uncomfortable with a joke, please let the host know immediately.
Respect your set length and the host's timing calls so the night runs smoothly.
Hosts may cut sets or skip performers if rules are ignored. Repeat violations can mean removal from future mics.

sections.title: For Audience Members
items: Be kind and present. Listen while performers are on stage and keep side conversations to a minimum.
No heckling, harassment, or threatening behavior.
Honor names, pronouns, and boundaries. If someone tells you a boundary, respect it immediately.
If something feels unsafe, find the host or organizer right away. We will listen and act.

sections.title: Accountability & Safety
items: Organizers can warn, remove, or deny entry to anyone who violates these expectations.
Safety calls are made to protect the room, this is a safe space first and foremost. We appreciate your cooperation.
If you need to report an issue privately, email us at mercymecomedy@gmail.com.
